exceptions.justification: No patched release exists (vulnerable >=4.2.0 <=4.3.1, fixed: none — latest is 4.3.1). Present only inside dev tooling — jest-config and @rollup/plugin-node-resolve (via workbox-build) — merging our own static config objects at build/test time. Never reaches the production bundle and never processes untrusted input, so prototype poisoning of the returned object has no attacker-controlled path.
